title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
description: Context: This PR hardens RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and audit logging to meet cross-team compliance requirements (data residency, KMS scoping) and to reduce risk observed during recent incident INT-2025-09. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require deterministic KMS key residency enforcement and complete, tamper-evident audit trails at the RBAC enforcement boundary. This change implements: 1) enforcement path for kms_region_pin on protected resources with a new RBAC policy check that rejects mis-scoped keys when 'enforce_kms_region' feature flag is on; 2) richer audit events emitted by the RBAC decision engine including key_id, requested_region, enforcement_outcome, and fallback_reason; 3) unit and integration tests for policy evaluation, audit formatting, and telemetry; 4) migration helper that converts existing policy YAML with audit-level overrides into explicit kms_region_pin rules and emits a preview report. Changes are backwards compatible when feature flag is off and include a migration plan for customers. Checklist: - [x] implement enforcement gate and policy evaluator hook - [x] emit new audit fields and ensure logs are structured JSON - [x] add unit tests (policy, evaluator, log formatting) - [x] add integration test against private-installer smoke cluster - [x] update docs and release notes - [x] smoke tested on staging with sample tenant. Testing & verification: local unit test suite, CI integration tests, staging run using private-installer image with sample KMS impersonation. Observability: new metrics rbac.enforce_kms_region.total, rbac.enforce_kms_region.denied and audit log parsing patterns added to observability-pack dashboards. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated rollout over three stages (off -> audit-only -> enforce) with migration-preview run in audit-only for 7 days; follow-up to enable enforcement for specific clients via Linear ENG-5721. Backward compatibility & migration: when 'enforce_kms_region' is false, behavior is unchanged (audit-only). The migration helper writes a preview CSV and an idempotent policy transform; ops must run the helper and review before flipping enforcement. Known limitations: cross-account KMS aliases are validated by key_arn prefix heuristics; full KMS API validation is a follow-up tracked in ENG-5789. Related work: ENG-5721, SEC-203, INT-2025-09.
